prompt: The client asks: "Should we launch the premium dog food line nationally?" Fact sheet: the premium segment is worth $800M and growing 12% a year; the line reached 1% share in a test market; break-even requires a 2% share; the national launch costs $10M; our company sponsors a dog show. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: Break-even needs a 2% share, but the test market reached only 1%, even though the $800M premium segment is growing 12% a year. The main risk is that a competitor takes the premium space while we wait. Putting it together, don't launch nationally yet.
options.feedback: The answer comes last. Lead with the recommendation, then support it.
